user.title: Configure Tibber Prices
user.description:
Enter your Tibber API Access Token.

You can generate one at [developer.tibber.com](https://developer.tibber.com/).

home.title: Select Home
home.description: Select the home you want to track prices for.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Tibber Prices
reauth_confirm.description: The current access token is invalid or expired. Please enter a new Tibber API Access Token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tibber Prices
reconfigure.description: Update your Tibber API Access Token.

error.no_homes_found: No homes found on this account
error.home_not_found_with_token: The previously configured home was not found with this token

clear_cache.name: Clear Cache
clear_cache.description: Clears the cache for all configured Tibber Prices entries and forces a refresh of the price data.
